content.text: The renewal terms fully match our preferred position.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand. Failure to send the reminder extends Customer's opt-out deadline until thirty days after the reminder is received.
input.rationale: § 8.2 provides automatic renewals of exactly twelve months (not multi-year), with a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice — at the preferred ≤30-day threshold — plus a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal and a backstop extending our opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent. § 8.3 caps renewal uplifts at the lesser of CPI and three percent, requires ninety days' notice of any increase, and confirms no increase applies to prepaid periods. § 8.1 sets a three-year master term but expressly does not auto-renew, and Order Form renewals remain annual. This meets the preferred position on renewal term length, notice window, reminder, and price cap; no redline needed.
